whatIs: Lapa Ninja is a landing page gallery with more than 7,300 designs since 2015, with full-page screenshots and video recordings of each site. Besides whole sites, it separates out individual sections, animations, OG images and fonts, and keeps earlier versions of the same site.
It's a good fit when you're designing a landing page and want to see the full page from top to bottom, not just the hero, and compare how a site changed over time.
uses: Scrolling through the full screenshots of several SaaS landing pages to decide the order of your own sections.
Looking up just the section you're missing, like a pricing table or a footer, in the Sections area.
Comparing a site's earlier versions to see how its messaging or design evolved.
caveats: The free plan shows ads and limits the boards for saving sites; Pro removes both.
The menu mixes the gallery with courses, templates and site-building tools, so it's best to go straight to Websites or Sections.
It focuses on landing pages and marketing sites; for app screens there are more specific galleries.
pricingNote: The gallery is free to browse; Pro costs $9 per month and removes the ads and the board limit.
idealFor: Designing a landing page by looking at real full pages and sections.
